paper_title: Revised constraints and Belle II sensitivity for visible and invisible axion-like particles
suggested_experiment_name: ALP photon coupling combined constraints (Dolan et al. 2017)
notes: Paper presents revised constraints and Belle II projected sensitivity for ALPs coupling to photons (g_agamma in GeV^-1) vs ALP mass in keV-GeV range. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton. However, data is only available in plots (figures 2, 4, 7) with no numerical tables provided in the text, so no reliable (mass, coupling) data points could be extracted. Belle II projections are at 90% CL; collider/beam dump bounds at 95% CL. Includes both photon coupling and hypercharge coupling scenarios. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Figure 2 left panel (photon coupling, g_aZ=0). Lower boundary traced is dominated by SN 1987A and SN 1987A (a->gamma gamma) constraints at low mass, then electron/proton beam dumps and e+e->gamma gamma at higher mass. The plot overlays multiple constraint regions; this traces the lower envelope of the combined excluded region. X-axis in GeV converted to eV.
